description: This file contains Redux action creators and utility functions for polling user statuses, profiles, and handling mentions in a Mattermost Redux-based application.

methods.name: addUserIdsForStatusFetchingPoll
methods.description: Adds user IDs to the status polling queue, manages polling interval.

methods.name: addUserIdsForProfileFetchingPoll
methods.description: Adds user IDs to the profile polling queue, manages polling interval.

methods.name: cleanUpStatusAndProfileFetchingPoll
methods.description: Stops polling intervals for status and profile data.

methods.name: extractUserIdsAndMentionsFromPosts
methods.description: Extracts user IDs and mentions from posts for polling and fetching.

methods.name: batchFetchStatusesProfilesGroupsFromPosts
methods.description: Batch fetches user profiles, statuses, and groups based on posts.

methods.name: getUsersFromMentionedUsernamesAndGroups
methods.description: Fetches user profiles and groups based on mentioned usernames and group names.
